lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, new_flow', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'home, redesign', as each has only 1 test.
For 'adoption, redesign', noise-corrected results consistently show ~+2.5% gain across 2 tests; it proved helpful when significant (Round 6), though Round 4 showed no clear effect.
Predictions for 'adoption, redesign' were accurate compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions were too high for 'adoption, new_flow', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'home, redesign' compared to noise-corrected results.

candidates.title: Path Selection Benefit Spotlight Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen with a spotlight layout comparing preset adoption speed against custom pet creation.
candidates.why: choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s and 76.2% conversion, indicating user hesitation between selection paths.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Meet Your Desktop Pet
choose_path.body: Pick a ready companion for quick setup or create a personalized pet from your photos.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Account Persistence Warning Flow
candidates.change: Add an explicit persistence notice and backup callout during sign-in to explain why account creation preserves pet data.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet Across Sessions
sign_in.body: Creating or signing into your account keeps your desktop pet safe and synchronized.

guard.reason: Valid sign-in component and copy update within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High support ticket volume (8 emails) supports sign-in persistence fixes, though new flows carry release overhead.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet naming and confirmation step right after adoption photo upload.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is 70.2% and 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation result issues.

new_cert_confirmation.headline: Confirm Pet Details
new_cert_confirmation.body: Review your pet's name and photo setup before issuing the official certificate.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a confirmation screen within onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Target step drop is high, but historical new_screen tests showed negative lift (-0.8%).

candidates.title: Pet Rendering Progress Time Estimate
candidates.change: Display explicit progress stages and estimated completion time on the waiting screen while background assets render.
candidates.why: The waiting screen ('home' step) has a long mean duration of 2336s, leading to user abandonment before desktop launch.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home
waiting.body: Setting up graphics assets and desktop integration.

guard.reason: Valid addition of rendering progress and time estimate on waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high waiting duration (2336s mean) on home step with progress indicators.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Card Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a two-column summary highlighting desktop hotkeys, visibility controls, and pet interaction modes.
candidates.why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and multiple support mails report confusion over hiding or controlling desktop pets.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Learn how to summon, move, or hide your desktop pet anytime.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Late Sign In Flow Reorder
candidates.change: Reorder onboarding so users pick or create their pet before being asked to sign in.
candidates.why: Sign in conversion is 72.9% and early authentication before choosing a pet creates friction.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of sign-in step after adoption certificate.

candidates.score_note: Reduces early friction by delaying 27.1% sign-in drop step until after pet selection.

candidates.title: Photo Requirements Guidance Copy
candidates.change: Clarify image requirements on the photo upload screen with clear text guidelines regarding lighting and background contrast.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes.

upload_photos.headline: Upload a Clear, Well-Lit Photo
upload_photos.body: For best pet generation, use a single clear photo with good lighting and simple background.
upload_photos.hint: Avoid heavy shadows or blurry close-ups.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on photo upload screen providing visual guidance.

candidates.score_note: Low cost config-only copy tweak directly backed by 3 support tickets and 29.8% adoption drop.

candidates.title: Background Waiting Activity Hints
candidates.change: Display rotating tip carousels during the waiting screen to inform users what the desktop pet can do once ready.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high median/mean duration (201s / 2336s), causing drop-off while pet setup finishes.

waiting.hint: Tip: You can move your pet anywhere on screen by dragging it.

guard.reason: Valid addition of helpful tip carousel during waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Engages users during 201s median render wait, though target step drop is lower than finish/adoption.

candidates.title: First Interaction Welcome Badge
candidates.change: Add an achievement badge visual element on the launch screen encouraging users to complete the final setup step.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion drops from 81.3% home to 64.8% finish step.

guard.reason: Valid visual badge element added to home_intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has highest drop (35.2%), but previous finish step changes showed negative lift (-1.1%).

candidates.title: Single Tap Authentication Layout
candidates.change: Switch the sign_in screen to a centered layout with prominent quick auth choices and backup sign in options.
candidates.why: 2 support tickets reported sign-in stalls or missing sign in screens, and sign-in drop-off is 27.1%.

guard.reason: Valid layout update to sign-in screen within onboarding bounds.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 27.1% sign-in drop and 2 support tickets regarding sign-in stalls.
